mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within three months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.5% within three months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts by more than 5% over three months signals increased demand for housing and related goods, boosting economic activity and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST increased by more than 5% within three months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% over two months signals increased supply-side activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% within two months.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate decreases by more than 0.2% within a month, it signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200,000 and UNRATE decrease > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% over three months signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as borrowing costs decrease and economic activity accelerates.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreased by more than 0.5% within three months.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures increase by more than 1% and the consumer price index increases by more than 0.5% within a month, it signals strong demand and inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate tighter monetary policy.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase > 1% and CPIAUCSL increase > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 2% over two months signals a contraction in supply-side activity, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO decreased by more than 2% within two months.
